result_text:
The per-rep purchase-order count now leaves out cancelled purchase orders. I didn't add a test for your Anna/Bob example.

The change is one condition, `po.status <> 'CANCELLED'`, added to the subquery in `DataStore.findPurchaseOrderCountPerSalesRep` (`src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java`, around line 6517). It's the same filter the other purchase-order reports use. I left the ordering and the `sales_rep` base table alone, so reps with no purchase orders in the period are still listed with 0, highest count first.

I ran the `*PurchaseOrder*` tests and they pass. I haven't committed anything.
